description: FK tới Security Trading Snapshot Dimension
etl_logic: LOOKUP security_trading_snpst_dim ON security_trading_snpst_dim.symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol

description: FK tới Public Company Dimension
etl_logic: INNER JOIN public_company ON public_company.equity_ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.symbol → LOOKUP public_company_dim ON public_company_dim.public_company_code = public_company.pc_code

description: FK tới Calendar Date Dimension

description: FK tới Index Constituent Dimension — nullable khi mã CK không thuộc rổ chỉ số nào
